1: ## 1. Project Setup
2: 
3: - [x] 1.1 Initialize Next.js project with TypeScript, TailwindCSS, and App Router
4: - [x] 1.2 Install dependencies: shadcn/ui, jspdf, jspdf-autotable, lucide-react, uuid
5: - [x] 1.3 Configure shadcn/ui components (Button, Input, Select, Card, Dialog, Table, Label, Separator)
6: - [x] 1.4 Set up project folder structure: `components/`, `lib/`, `types/`
7: 
8: ## 2. Data Model & Types
9: 
10: - [x] 2.1 Define TypeScript types for StatementEntry (id, statementType, description, category, closingBalance, ownershipPercentage, effectiveValue)
11: - [x] 2.2 Define TypeScript types for UserProfile (fullName, address, certificateDate, asOnDate)
12: - [x] 2.3 Define statement type presets with default category mappings (assets: Savings Bank Account, Fixed Deposit, PPF, Mutual Fund, Stock Holdings, Real Estate, Gold/Jewellery, Other Asset; liabilities: Home Loan, Personal Loan, Car Loan, Credit Card Outstanding, Education Loan, Other Liability)
13: 
14: ## 3. State Management & localStorage Persistence
15: 
16: - [x] 3.1 Create custom hook useStatements for managing statement entries (add, edit, delete) with localStorage auto-save and restore
17: - [x] 3.2 Create custom hook useUserProfile for managing user profile data with localStorage auto-save and restore
18: 
19: ## 4. User Profile Form
20: 
21: - [x] 4.1 Build UserProfileForm component with fields: full name (required), address, certificate date (default today), as-on date (required)
22: - [x] 4.2 Add validation: full name and as-on date are required; display inline errors
23: 
24: ## 5. Statement Management UI
25: 
26: - [x] 5.1 Build StatementForm component (add/edit mode) with fields: statement type (dropdown with presets), description, category (auto-filled from preset, editable), closing balance (non-negative validation), ownership percentage (1-100, default 100)
27: - [x] 5.2 Build StatementList component displaying all entries in a table grouped by assets and liabilities, showing closing balance, ownership %, and effective value
28: - [x] 5.3 Add edit and delete actions per statement entry row
29: - [x] 5.4 Implement validation: reject negative closing balance, reject ownership % outside 1-100
30: 
31: ## 6. Net Worth Computation & Live Summary
32: 
33: - [x] 6.1 Implement computeEffectiveValue function: closingBalance × ownershipPercentage / 100
34: - [x] 6.2 Implement computeTotals function: total assets, total liabilities, net worth
35: - [x] 6.3 Build NetWorthSummary component displaying live total assets, total liabilities, and net worth, updating in real-time as entries change
36: 
37: ## 7. PDF Certificate Generation
38: 
39: - [x] 7.1 Implement Indian currency formatting utility (₹12,50,000.00 format)
40: - [x] 7.2 Build PDF generation function using jsPDF + jspdf-autotable: certificate header with user profile details, itemized assets table, itemized liabilities table (or "Nil"), net worth summary
41: - [x] 7.3 Add "Generate Certificate" button with validation check (full name and as-on date required, at least one entry exists)
42: - [x] 7.4 Implement PDF download with filename format: NetWorth_Certificate_<fullName>_<asOnDate>.pdf
43: 
44: ## 8. Main Page Layout & Integration
45: 
46: - [x] 8.1 Build main page layout integrating UserProfileForm, StatementForm, StatementList, NetWorthSummary, and Generate Certificate button
47: - [x] 8.2 Style the page with TailwindCSS for a clean, professional look with responsive design
48: - [x] 8.3 Add app header/branding and footer
49: 
50: ## 9. Testing & Polish
51: 
52: - [x] 9.1 Test full flow: add profile → add assets/liabilities with various ownership % → generate PDF → verify PDF contents
53: - [x] 9.2 Test edge cases: no entries, only assets, only liabilities, negative net worth, 0% and 100% ownership boundary
54: - [x] 9.3 Test localStorage persistence across page refresh
55: - [x] 9.4 Cross-browser testing (Chrome, Firefox, Edge)
